era: 中世纪盛期（西西里—巴黎—科隆—那不勒斯）：从十字军时代的亚里士多德回传到经院哲学的顶点与正统化
school: 神学/经院哲学/亚里士多德主义/自然神学 / Theology / Scholasticism / Aristotelianism / Natural Theology
historical_significance: 中世纪最重要的哲学家-神学家，托马斯主义的创立者。核心方法论：以『恩典不摧毁自然而成全自然』为纲领，把刚被拉丁世界重新发现的亚里士多德全面整合进基督教神学——在基督徒皆拒亚里士多德的巴黎，他论证异教哲学家的理性本身是通向真理的合法通道；以『五路』证明把上帝存在从信仰命题改写为可公开论证的哲学命题（从运动、因果、偶然、等级、目的五条经验出发点倒推第一因）；以第一活动/第二活动的双重真理分界把信仰命题与理性命题分账管理，既不越界用哲学裁决奥秘、也不允许神学冒充哲学论证；以『正反并陈』的经院问难结构（quaestio）把一切争议制度化——每个问题先摆最强反方论证、再摆己方裁决、最后逐条回应反方，使论辩结构本身成为对抗稻草人谬误的方法装置；以概念精密化工程为每一个神学-哲学术语（存在/本质、实体/偶性、恩宠/功德）下定义、划边界、分异解；以《神学大全》的百科式架构把全部神学变成可检索、可教学、自足开放的课程体系——每个问题自成单元、互相引用、留出未完成处供后人续写。他是把信仰与理性、启示与哲学、传统与异教新知四条线拧成一根经院主轴的转换器式人物。
historical_significance_en: The most important philosopher-theologian of the High Middle Ages and the founder of Thomism. Core methodology: taking 'grace does not destroy nature but perfects it' as his program, he integrated the newly rediscovered Aristotle wholesale into Christian theology—arguing in a Paris where Christians shunned the Philosopher that the reason of pagan thinkers is itself a legitimate channel to truth; through the Five Ways he rewrote God's existence from an article of faith into a publicly arguable philosophical thesis (back-inferring a first mover, first cause, necessary being, maximal being, and final order from five empirical starting points); with the two-fold truth bookkeeping of the first act and the second act he kept articles of faith and rationally demonstrable claims in separate ledgers—neither philosophizing over mysteries nor letting theology counterfeit philosophical proof; with the quaestio structure of sic et non he institutionalized every controversy—state the strongest opposing arguments first, render the master's ruling, then reply to each objection in turn, making the structure of debate itself a device against the straw man; through a conceptual precision engineering for each theological-philosophical term (existence/essence, substance/accident, grace/merit) he defined, bounded, and distinguished; and with the encyclopedic architecture of the Summa Theologiae he turned all of theology into a retrievable, teachable, self-sufficient yet open curriculum—each question a self-contained unit, cross-cited, with unfinished places left for successors. He was the converter-figure who twisted faith and reason, revelation and philosophy, tradition and pagan new learning into one scholastic spine.

modes.domain_zh: 把异教哲学与传统神学整合为一个体系/拒绝在真理问题上站队宗派
modes.domain_en: Integrating Pagan Philosophy with Received Theology into One System / Refusing Factional Sides on Truth
modes.definition_zh: 十三世纪中叶的拉丁西方面临一个知识主权危机：亚里士多德的全套著作经由阿拉伯注释者（阿维森纳、阿威罗伊）回传，在巴黎大学引发震荡——主流神学界视之为异教毒物，拉丁阿威罗伊派则用它拆毁启示权威，两派都在『站队』而非『整合』。阿奎那的纲领是一句格言：『恩典不摧毁自然，而是成全自然』（gratia non tollit naturam, sed perficit）。方法上这意味着三步：其一，承认一切真理最终同源——哲学与神学是同一真理的两个入口，凡理性确证者为真，凡启示昭示者为真，真不会与真冲突；其二，对来自『敌对阵营』的知识不因出身而拒收，而是逐条做来源审计：这条结论的证据是经验观察还是公理演绎？它与已确立的真理是否真的冲突，还是只是与某个表述冲突？其三，把审计通过的异教知识原样吸收进体系核心——他在《神学大全》中引用亚里士多德达数千处，称之『那位哲学家』而不加『异教的』限定语，等于在基督教正统的地理中心为异教理性立法。方法签名：当知识版图上出现新的大陆时，驱逐它或跪拜它都是懒惰，真正的工程是把它测绘进自己的地图——权威的合法性来自其结论能否经受整合审计，而非其出身。
modes.definition_en: Mid-thirteenth-century Latin Christendom faced a crisis of intellectual sovereignty: the complete works of Aristotle, returning through Arab commentators (Avicenna, Averroes), convulsed the University of Paris—mainstream theology branded them pagan poison, while the Latin Averroists used them to dismantle the authority of revelation. Both camps were picking sides, not integrating. Aquinas's program was one maxim: 'grace does not destroy nature but perfects it' (gratia non tollit naturam, sed perficit). Methodologically this means three steps: first, concede that all truth ultimately has one source—philosophy and theology are two entrances to the same truth; whatever reason establishes is true, whatever revelation discloses is true, and truth cannot conflict with truth. Second, knowledge from the 'hostile camp' is not rejected for its origin but audited item by item: is this conclusion's evidence empirical observation or axiomatic deduction? Does it truly conflict with established truth, or only with some formulation of it? Third, absorb the audited pagan knowledge into the core of the system intact—he cites Aristotle thousands of times in the Summa Theologiae as 'the Philosopher' without the qualifier 'pagan,' effectively legislating for pagan reason at the geographic center of Christian orthodoxy. Method signature: when a new continent appears on the map of knowledge, expelling it or kneeling to it are both laziness; the real work is surveying it into your own map—an authority's legitimacy comes from whether its conclusions pass the integration audit, not from where they were born.
modes.source_chapter: 《神学大全》第一集第一题『神圣教义的性质与范围』；『恩典成全自然』纲领见第一集第一题第八释疑；《反异教大全》全书架构
modes.key_quote_zh: 恩典不摧毁自然，而是成全自然——凡是真的，就不是信仰的敌人。
modes.key_quote_en: Grace does not destroy nature but perfects it—whatever is true is no enemy of faith.
process_zh: 确立同源公理：理性与启示是同一真理的两个通道，凡双方确证者不可能互相冲突
对新兴敌对知识逐条来源审计：区分其证据类型（经验/演绎）、检验其与已确立真理的真实冲突点
把表述冲突与实质冲突分开：若仅措辞冲突则改译术语纳入，若实质冲突则升级为专门问题处理
审计通过者原样纳入体系核心并正式授名（如『那位哲学家』），使其成为体系的承重结构而非装饰
process_en: Set the one-source axiom: reason and revelation are two channels of the same truth; what both confirm cannot conflict
Audit each piece of incoming hostile knowledge: classify its evidence (empirical/deductive) and locate the true point of conflict with established truth
Separate conflicts of formulation from conflicts of substance: re-translate terminology to absorb the former; promote the latter to a dedicated question
Admit what passes the audit intact into the system's core and name it formally ('the Philosopher'), making it load-bearing structure rather than ornament
representative_cases_zh: 巴黎的亚里士多德收编（1260s）：在教会禁令未解、同僚皆拒的气氛中，他把亚里士多德的形而上学、自然哲学、伦理学全幅纳入《神学大全》的骨架——被后世称为『哲学史上最大的收编工程』
《反异教大全》的写作策略：面向无法共享圣经权威的读者，他前四卷刻意只使用理性论证与双方共同接受的权威——整合以对方可检验的公共证据为地基
对阿威罗伊派的双重立场：他吸收亚里士多德却逐条驳斥阿威罗伊的注释（如双重真理论、理智单一论）——收编知识不等于收编其诠释者
反例警示：1277年巴黎宗教当局谴责二百余条命题，其中多条与阿奎那的整合方案相关，托马斯主义一度受挫——整合工程的成功依赖制度环境，整合者本人可能死于自己试图整合的双方的夹击
representative_cases_en: The Aristotle assimilation in Paris (1260s): amid an unresolved ban and colleagues' rejection, he took Aristotle's metaphysics, natural philosophy, and ethics wholesale into the skeleton of the Summa Theologiae—called the greatest assimilation project in the history of philosophy

The writing strategy of Summa Contra Gentiles: addressing readers who cannot share the authority of Scripture, the first four books deliberately use only rational argument and authorities accepted by both sides—integration built on evidence both parties can check

His double stance on Averroism: he absorbed Aristotle while refuting Averroes' commentaries point by point (the double-truth doctrine, the unity of intellect)—assimilating a body of knowledge is not assimilating its interpreter

Cautionary case: the Paris condemnations of 1277 censured over two hundred propositions, several tied to Aquinas's integration scheme, and Thomism faltered for a generation—the success of an integration project depends on the institutional environment; the integrator may be caught in the crossfire of both sides he tried to join
modern_applications_zh: 跨学科整合：吸收新领域（如行为经济学进入政策设计）时逐条审计证据类型与真实冲突点，拒绝『门派论』式整体拒绝或整体皈依
技术选型：对竞品/开源方案做来源审计后原样采纳其审计通过部分，并在架构文档中正式致名——吸收不丢署名
组织变革：把被并购团队的方法论写进主体流程（『成全自然』），而非推倒重来——降低整合阻力
个人学习：面对与既有世界观冲突的新知识，先做『表述冲突还是实质冲突』的分辨，再决定修订哪一边
modern_applications_en: Interdisciplinary integration: when absorbing a new field (say, behavioral economics into policy design), audit each claim's evidence type and real conflict points—refusing both wholesale tribal rejection and wholesale conversion

Technology selection: after source-auditing a competitor or open-source solution, adopt the parts that pass verbatim and credit them formally in the architecture docs—absorption without de-attribution
Organizational change: write the acquired team's methodology into the parent processes ('perfecting nature') rather than rebuilding from zero—lowering integration friction
Personal learning: when new knowledge clashes with your worldview, first distinguish a conflict of formulation from one of substance, then decide which side to revise

modes.name_en: Five-Ways Back-Inference to a First Cause
modes.domain_zh: 自然神学/从可观察现象倒推超验结论
modes.domain_en: Natural Theology / Back-Inferring Transcendent Conclusions from Observable Phenomena
modes.definition_zh: 在信仰命题无法对异教徒有效的地方，阿奎那把『上帝存在』改写为一个可公开论证的哲学问题，给出五条证明（quinque viae）。方法论的关键不在结论而在起点结构：五条路各自从一个人人可复核的经验事实出发——万物在运动（第一路：运动者链条必有不动的推动者）；因果链条中无一物是自己的原因（第二路：必有不假外因的第一因）；存在物中有的会消失、故本可以不存在（第三路：偶然存在者必然预设必然存在者）；事物有程度的完满（第四路：程度的比较预设极值）；无理性事物也规律地趋向目的（第五路：非意图的规律性预设安排者）。每一路都是同一个推理动作：从经验中确定无疑的『链条现象』出发，追问『这条链如何可能』，倒推出链条的必然起点——推论的每一步都只用逻辑与公共经验，不偷渡任何启示内容；推论结束时所得的也只是『第一因/必然者』这样的哲学概念，而非基督教的上帝——他明确说五路只证明哲学性的第一因，三位一体等教义须靠启示。方法签名：把最大争议的结论改写为从最小争议的起点出发的必然推理链；证明的公信力等于其最弱一步的公信力，因此每一步都必须使用对方也接受的公理。
modes.definition_en: Where articles of faith carry no force with unbelievers, Aquinas rewrote 'God exists' as a publicly arguable philosophical question and offered five proofs (quinque viae). The methodological key lies not in the conclusions but in the structure of the starting points: each way begins from an empirical fact anyone can verify—all things move (first way: a chain of movers must terminate in an unmoved mover); nothing in a causal chain is its own cause (second way: there must be a first cause owing nothing to another); some beings cease to exist and so could not exist (third way: contingent beings presuppose a necessary being); things possess degrees of perfection (fourth way: gradation presupposes a maximum); even irrational things act regularly for an end (fifth way: non-intentional regularity presupposes an orderer). Each way performs the same inferential move: from an undisputed 'chain phenomenon' in experience, ask 'how is this chain possible' and back-infer the chain's necessary terminus—every step uses only logic and public experience, smuggling in no revealed content; and the terminus reached is only a philosophical concept like 'first cause,' not the Christian God—he explicitly says the Five Ways prove only the philosophical first cause, while the Trinity must rest on revelation. Method signature: rewrite the most contested conclusion as a necessary inference from the least contested starting points; a proof's credibility equals the credibility of its weakest step, so every step must use axioms the opponent also accepts.
modes.source_chapter: 《神学大全》第一集第二题第三条『上帝是否存在』的五路证明；《反异教大全》第一卷的平行论证
modes.key_quote_zh: 证明的每一步都必须站在对手也承认的地面上——从万物皆动这一事实出发，不需要任何信仰。
modes.key_quote_en: Every step of the proof must stand on ground the opponent also grants—starting from the fact that things move, no faith is required.
process_zh: 选定零争议的经验起点：链条现象（运动、因果、偶然、等级、秩序），其存在连最深的怀疑者也承认
分析链条的可能性条件：追问『这个无限链条或循环如何可能』，形式化其自相矛盾之处
倒推必然终点：以逻辑必然性（而非概率）推出链条的起点或根基，结论恰止于逻辑所需的最小实体
为结论划界：明确说明证明了什么、未证明什么——不把哲学结论偷换为神学教义，也不反过来
process_en: Choose a zero-dispute empirical starting point: a chain phenomenon (motion, causality, contingency, gradation, order) whose existence even the deepest skeptic grants
Analyze the chain's conditions of possibility: ask how the infinite chain or regress could stand, formalizing where it contradicts itself
Back-infer the necessary terminus: derive the chain's origin or ground by logical necessity, stopping at exactly the minimal entity the logic requires
Bound the conclusion: state explicitly what has and has not been proved—neither smuggling doctrine into the philosophical result nor the reverse
representative_cases_zh: 第一路（运动论证，约1265-1274写定）：从『万物皆被推动』推出『不动的推动者』——两千余年里被反复攻击、反复重建，至今仍是形而上学课程的标准案例
第五路（目的论证）：从自然物如箭矢般趋向目标的规律性推出安排者——该推理形态在当代以『宇宙微调论证』的形式复活
结论的刻意克制：他在《神学大全》中明言，五路只能证明『第一因』存在，无法证明『三位一体』——与流行的『上帝证明』误解相反，他自己给证明划了界
反例警示：康德后来批判一切『宇宙论式』证明都暗中依赖本体论证明——阿奎那链条中最弱一环（从『链条必有起点』到『起点即所论者』）确实依赖因果原则的普适性；倒推法的结论不超过其最弱前提的强度
representative_cases_en: The first way (written c. 1265-1274): from 'everything is moved' to 'an unmoved mover'—attacked and rebuilt for over seven centuries, still the standard case in metaphysics courses
The fifth way (teleological): from nature's arrow-like regularity toward ends to an orderer—the same inferential form revived in our day as the fine-tuning argument

Deliberate restraint of the conclusion: in the Summa he states that the Five Ways prove only that a first cause exists, not the Trinity—contrary to the popular myth of 'proofs of God,' he drew the proof's boundary himself

Cautionary case: Kant later charged that all cosmological proofs covertly depend on the ontological argument—the weakest link in Aquinas's chain (from 'the chain must have a terminus' to 'the terminus is the being in question') indeed leans on the universal validity of the causal principle; a back-inference's conclusion is never stronger than its weakest premise
modern_applications_zh: 产品论证：把『必须采用方案X』改写为从对方也承认的观测数据出发的必然推理链，每一步标注所依赖的公理
架构论证：从『我们观察到每周三次数据不一致』倒推出『必须有单一事实源』——结论恰好止于逻辑所需的最小架构承诺
谈判策略：把争议目标拆解为对方已接受的小前提之和，使拒绝结论等于拒绝其自己的前提
批判性审查：评估任何推理链时专攻最弱一环——结论的公信力不可能超过该环节
modern_applications_en: Product argument: rewrite 'we must adopt X' as a necessary inference from observational data the other side already grants, annotating the axiom each step relies on

Architecture argument: back-infer from 'we observe three data inconsistencies weekly' to 'there must be a single source of truth'—stopping at exactly the minimal architectural commitment logic requires
Negotiation: decompose the contested goal into small premises the counterpart already accepts, so rejecting the conclusion means rejecting one's own premise
Critical review: when auditing any inference chain, attack the weakest link—the conclusion's credibility cannot exceed it

modes.domain_zh: 把信仰命题与理性命题分账管理/防止两个知识领域互相越权
modes.domain_en: Keeping Articles of Faith and Rationally Demonstrable Claims in Separate Ledgers / Preventing Two Knowledge Domains from Usurping Each Other
modes.definition_zh: 面对『哲学能证明多少、神学必须保留多少』的划界问题，阿奎那发明了一套精细的分账系统：真理命题按『可证明性』分为三级——第一级是理性可完全证明的（上帝存在、灵魂不朽式的自然命题）；第二级是理性既不能证明也不能否证的（三位一体、道成肉身，他称『超越理性的奥秘』而非『违反理性』）；第三级是理性可以否证的（如永世恒常的世界——他认为理性可证明世界有开端这个说法站不住，该教义只能靠启示持有）。分账的直接对立面是两个错误：拉丁阿威罗伊派的『双重真理论』（哲学与神学可各自为真、互相矛盾——他视之为对真理本身的毁灭），与神学家的越界（用圣经字义裁决几何问题、用哲学『证明』奥秘）。分账方法的运作要点是双向的：理性不得裁决奥秘，奥秘也不得冒充证明；但两级之间存在受控接口——哲学可为奥秘『清除障碍』（反驳与之矛盾的伪论证），启示可为哲学『指明界限』。方法签名：健康的知识体系需要科目之间的分账簿而非单一总账——把每个命题登记到它恰当的账本上，冲突多数不是真理之间的冲突，而是记错了账。
modes.definition_en: Facing the boundary question 'how much can philosophy prove, how much must theology keep,' Aquinas invented a fine-grained ledger: truth-claims are classified by demonstrability into three tiers—first, what reason can fully prove (natural truths such as God's existence); second, what reason can neither prove nor disprove (Trinity, Incarnation—'mysteries exceeding reason,' never 'contradicting reason'); third, what reason can refute (e.g., an eternally world—he held that reason cannot prove the world's beginning, so that doctrine rests on revelation alone). The ledger's direct opposites are two errors: the Latin Averroists' double-truth theory (philosophy and theology true in their own spheres yet contradictory—he saw this as destroying truth itself) and the theologians' overreach (deciding geometry by the letter of Scripture, 'proving' mysteries philosophically). The ledger works in both directions: reason must not adjudicate mysteries, mysteries must not counterfeit proofs; yet the tiers have a controlled interface—philosophy may 'clear obstacles' for mysteries by refuting contradictory pseudo-arguments, and revelation may 'mark boundaries' for philosophy. Method signature: a healthy knowledge system needs ledgers per domain, not one general ledger—register each proposition in its proper book, for most conflicts are not between truths but between misfled entries.
modes.source_chapter: 《神学大全》第一集第一题（圣教义 vs 哲学科学的分工与级别）；第一集第四十六题（世界的永恒性：理性不可证明）；《反异教大全》第一卷第三至九章
modes.key_quote_zh: 哲学为信仰清除障碍，信仰为哲学指明边界——两者是各自账本上的同一笔财富。
modes.key_quote_en: Philosophy clears obstacles for faith; faith marks boundaries for philosophy—the two are one treasure kept in separate ledgers.
process_zh: 为每个争议命题登记账本：先判定它属于理性可证明、奥秘不可证明、还是理性可否证三级中的哪一级
拒绝双重真理：若两本账出现实质矛盾，判定必有一方推理有误或记账有误——不存在『都对』的平行账本
建立受控接口：允许哲学反驳与奥秘冲突的伪论证（清除障碍），允许启示标注哲学推理的适用边界
审计越权行为：检查自己与对手是否用错了工具——用圣经裁决几何与用哲学『证明』奥秘同为违规
process_en: Register each contested proposition: classify it into one of three tiers—provably rational, undisprovable mystery, rationally refutable
Refuse double truth: if the two ledgers substantively conflict, rule that one side's reasoning or bookkeeping is wrong—no 'both true' parallel ledgers exist
Build the controlled interface: philosophy may refute pseudo-arguments conflicting with mystery (clearing obstacles); revelation may flag where philosophical inference leaves its domain
Audit usurpation: check whether you or your rival used the wrong tool—deciding geometry by Scripture and 'proving' mysteries by philosophy are the same violation
representative_cases_zh: 世界永恒性问题（第一集第四十六题）：他逐条论证理性既不能证明世界有开端、也不能证明世界永恒——把一个神学教义明确登记到『唯启示』账本，是分账法最著名的应用
驳双重真理论：1270年前后他著文痛斥阿威罗伊派『哲学按其原则为真、神学按其原则亦真』——分账不等于互相矛盾的账本并存
为奥秘清除障碍的示范：对三位一体，他不试图证明，而是逐一反驳『三位格不可能』的哲学论证——证明的缺席恰是方法自觉
反例警示：分账法在后世被简化为『理性归理性、信仰归信仰』的互不干涉主义，恰好滑向他本人最痛恨的双重真理论——分账的前提是承认两本账同属一个真理，缺了这个前提，分界就变成割据
representative_cases_en: The eternity of the world (I q.46): he argues point by point that reason can neither prove the world began nor that it is eternal—registering a doctrinal claim explicitly in the 'revelation-only' ledger, the ledger's most famous application
Against double truth: c. 1270 he wrote against the Averroists' 'true in philosophy, true in theology'—bookkeeping by domains is not the coexistence of contradictory books

Clearing obstacles for mystery: on the Trinity he attempts no proof but refutes, one by one, the philosophical arguments that 'three persons are impossible'—the absence of proof is itself method self-awareness

Cautionary case: later ages simplified the ledger into 'reason to reason, faith to faith' non-interference, sliding into exactly the double-truth theory he most detested—the ledger presupposes both books belong to one truth; without that premise, demarcation becomes partition
modern_applications_zh: 科学-价值分界：实证问题与规范问题分账管理——用数据回答『是什么』，用伦理框架回答『该不该』，拒绝两者互相冒充
AI 治理：把『模型能证明的』与『须由制度担保的』（对齐、问责）分账，防止用性能指标越权回答伦理问题
组织决策：事实判断（市场多大）与价值判断（我们要什么）分账讨论，冲突时先查记账是否错位
个人认知：区分『我论证过的信念』与『我接受为前提的信念』——后者的清单必须显式，防止其伪装成前者
modern_applications_en: Science-value boundary: manage empirical and normative questions in separate ledgers—data answers 'what is,' ethical frameworks answer 'what ought'—neither counterfeiting the other
AI governance: ledger 'what the model can demonstrate' separately from 'what institutions must guarantee' (alignment, accountability); performance metrics must not answer ethical questions
Organizational decisions: discuss factual judgments (how big is the market) and value judgments (what do we want) in separate books; on conflict, first check for misfiling
Personal cognition: distinguish beliefs you have argued for from beliefs you accept as premises—the latter's list must be explicit, kept from disguising itself as the former

modes.domain_zh: 论辩工程/把最强反方论证制度化地摆在自己论证之前
modes.domain_en: Argument Engineering / Institutionalizing the Strongest Objections before One's Own Case
modes.definition_zh: 阿贝拉尔十二世纪的《是与否》辑录了教父之间的相互矛盾，引发『权威打架怎么办』的危机；阿奎那把它转化为《神学大全》的问难结构（quaestio），使每个问题的处理固定为四段：第一，摆出反方论证（objectiones）——数量常达三五条、每条都以权威文本或严密推理的形式给出，且刻意选取对手观点的最强形式；第二，引入正方立场（sed contra，『然而相反』）——通常是一条权威引文，只立靶不定论；第三，大师裁决（respondeo）——正文论证，独立于双方引文的说服力；第四，逐条回应（responsio ad objectiones）——对开头摆出的每一条反方论证给出具体回应，指明它错在哪一步或混淆了什么。方法论要害有三：其一，反方论证的优先地位——最强反方被安置在结构的最前面，读者在听到正方之前必须先穿过反方；其二，裁决与回应分离——正论不靠驳倒反方来建立，反方的处理不承担正论的重负；其三，结构强制诚实——若你的回应逐条失败，文章自己就会暴露这一点。方法签名：把『预设对手是错的』这一人类默认倾向，用版式结构强制逆转为『先替对手把话说完、且说到最强』。
modes.definition_en: Abelard's twelfth-century Sic et Non compiled contradictions among the Church Fathers, provoking the crisis of 'what when authorities clash'; Aquinas converted it into the quaestio structure of the Summa Theologiae, fixing each question's treatment into four parts: first, the objections (objectiones)—commonly three to five, each stated as an authority text or tight argument, and deliberately chosen in the opponent's strongest form; second, the sed contra ('on the contrary')—usually one authoritative citation, setting the target without deciding; third, the master's ruling (respondeo)—the body argument, standing independent of either side's citations; fourth, the replies (ad objectiones)—a specific answer to each objection raised at the outset, locating its faulty step or confusion. Three essentials: the objections' priority—the strongest opposition is placed at the very front of the structure, so the reader must pass through it before hearing the affirmative; the separation of ruling and replies—the case is not built by demolishing the objections, and handling the objections bears none of the case's load; structural compulsion of honesty—if your replies fail one by one, the article itself exposes it. Method signature: the human default of 'assuming the opponent is wrong' is forcibly reversed by typography into 'finish the opponent's case first, and at its strongest.'
modes.source_chapter: 《神学大全》各问题的标准四段结构（objectiones / sed contra / respondeo / ad primum...）；阿贝拉尔《是与否》的先例
modes.key_quote_zh: 先让对手把话说完，而且说到最强——回应的位置在最后，但胜负在第一段就已注定。
modes.key_quote_en: Let the opponent finish first, and at full strength—the replies stand last, but the outcome is decided in the first section.
process_zh: 列出该问题的全部重要反方论证，逐一以对手可认可的最强形式重述，置于论证最前
以一条权威依据或公理立『然而相反』之靶——只表明立场方向，不预先承担论证责任
独立完成正文裁决（respondeo）：论证自身成立，不依赖对反方的驳斥
逐条回应最初的每一条反方论证：指明其错误步骤、混淆概念或失效条件，禁止笼统打发
process_en: Enumerate the question's significant opposing arguments, restating each in the strongest form the opponent would endorse, placed before the case
Set the sed contra with one authority or axiom—indicating direction of stance without pre-committing the argument
Complete the independent ruling (respondeo): the case must stand on its own, not on refuting the objections
Reply to each original objection in turn: identify its faulty step, confused concept, or lapsed condition—no summary dismissals
representative_cases_zh: 《神学大全》全书五千余个问难单元（1265-1274）：每一个都执行同一结构——教科书级的『把论辩伦理写成版式』工程，数百年来被译注、被模仿、被当成学术论文的远祖
『一位论者的论证』的处理示范：在讨论上帝简一性的问题上，他把认为『上帝非单纯』的最锐利的哲学论证置于首位，再在回应中逐条化解——对手越强，裁决越可信
与反方数量不对称的自觉：对争议小的问题他只摆两条反方，对争议大的（如圣事）摆到四五条——反方数量按争议烈度分配而非装饰性平均
反例警示：经院哲学后期，问难沦为操练——反方论证被故意写弱以便回应、逐条回应变成形式化套路；结构本身不能保证诚实，只在有人愿意诚实使用时才生效
representative_cases_en: The Summa's five-thousand-plus quaestio units (1265-1274): every one runs the same structure—the textbook 'argument ethics written as typography,' annotated, imitated, and taken as the distant ancestor of the academic paper

Model handling of a unitarian objection: on God's simplicity he fronts the sharpest philosophical arguments that 'God cannot be simple' and dissolves them reply by reply—the stronger the opponent, the more credible the ruling
Deliberate asymmetry in the count of objections: minor questions get two, major ones (like the sacraments) four or five—objection volume allocated by controversy, not evenly as ornament

Cautionary case: late scholasticism turned the quaestio into drill—objections deliberately weakened to make replies easy, point-by-point responses a formal routine; the structure guarantees honesty only when someone chooses to use it honestly
modern_applications_zh: 技术方案评审（RFC/设计文档）：强制设置『反方论证』章节，先列最强的反对理由再给方案，正文不依赖驳斥成立
学术论文写作：相关工作部分以对手最强形式陈述既有方案，回应部分逐条处理评审人可预见的三类反对
辩论与谈判训练：把『先完整复述对方立场并获其认可』固化为流程第一步——当代版 sed contra
决策备忘录：重大决策文档前置『最强的三个反对理由』，禁止放在附录或省略
modern_applications_en: Technical review (RFCs/design docs): mandate an 'objections' section—the strongest counterarguments listed before the proposal, the case not resting on rebuttal
Academic writing: state prior work in its strongest form in related work; anticipate and answer the three foreseeable classes of reviewer objection point by point
Debate and negotiation training: fix 'fully restate the counterpart's position and win their assent to the restatement' as step one—the contemporary sed contra
Decision memos: the three strongest objections precede any major decision document—never appendix, never omitted

modes.domain_zh: 为每个核心术语下定义、划边界、排查同词异解
modes.domain_en: Defining, Bounding, and Disambiguating Every Core Term
modes.definition_zh: 阿奎那接手的概念库大多来自翻译与传承——亚里士多德经阿拉伯文转译、教父术语经千年转手，同一个词背后往往是数种不同的概念。他的做法是对体系中的每一个核心术语执行三道工序：其一，定义（definitio）——用最近的属加种差给出严格定义，如『存在（esse）是现实性本身的一切完满』；其二，划界（divisio）——把易混的相邻概念成对切开：存在与本质、实体与偶性、潜能与实现、恩宠与功德、意志与理智，每一对都写明区分标准与混合使用时的谬误形态；其三，异解排查（dubium）——对该术语历史上的每一种不同理解列出清单、标注来源、判明分歧出在定义还是立场。这套工程的产出不是术语表而是论证的地基：后世所谓『托马斯主义的严密』，大半来自概念在被使用之前已经过三道工序。方法签名：争论的很大一部分是同词异义——先为每个关键词完成定义-划界-排查三道工序，再开始论证；一个未定义的术语在论证中等于一个未被拆除的炸弹。
modes.definition_en: The conceptual stock Aquinas inherited came largely through translation and transmission—Aristotle filtered through Arabic, patristic terms through a thousand years of hands—and one word often sheltered several concepts. His practice ran every core term of the system through three operations: definition (definitio)—a strict definition by proximate genus and specific difference, as 'existence (esse) is the actuality of every form or nature'; boundary-drawing (divisio)—cutting apart confusable neighbor concepts in pairs: existence and essence, substance and accident, potency and act, grace and merit, will and intellect, each pair with its criterion of distinction and the fallacy that mixed use produces; and disambiguation (dubium)—cataloguing every historical understanding of the term, tagging its source, and judging whether the divergence lies in definition or in stance. The output is not a glossary but a foundation for argument: what later ages call 'Thomist rigor' derives mostly from concepts having passed three operations before use. Method signature: a large share of dispute is homonymy—run definition, boundary-drawing, and disambiguation on every keyword before arguing; an undefined term in an argument is an unexploded bomb.
modes.source_chapter: 《论存在者与本质》(De Ente et Essentia) 全篇；《神学大全》第一集第三至十一题（上帝的单纯性、完满性、永恒性等概念的逐题精密化）；第一集第七十五至八十九题（灵魂概念工程）
modes.key_quote_zh: 在争论『存在』之前，先弄清你与对手所说的『存在』是不是同一个东西——一半的争论会当场消失。
modes.key_quote_en: Before disputing 'being,' first learn whether your 'being' and your opponent's are the same thing—half the dispute will vanish on the spot.
process_zh: 为每个核心术语写出严格定义：最近的属加种差，禁止用同义词循环定义
对易混概念成对划界：写明区分标准、各概念专属的使用场景与混合使用时的典型谬误
排查同词异解：列出该术语在传统中的每一种理解、其来源与立场归属，判明分歧层次
在全部论证中强制执行已定定义：一旦发现论证依赖某个未定义术语，暂停论证先补工序
process_en: Write a strict definition for every core term: proximate genus plus specific difference—no circular definition by synonym
Bound confusable concepts in pairs: state the criterion of distinction, each concept's proper use, and the typical fallacy of mixed use
Disambiguate homonyms: list every historical understanding of the term, its source and stance, and locate which level the divergence sits on
Enforce defined terms throughout: when an argument is found to rest on an undefined term, pause the argument and run the operations first
representative_cases_zh: 存在与本质之别（De Ente et Essentia，约1256）：他以『本质可被思考而不知其是否存在』切分两个自古混用的概念——这一划界成为后世形而上学的标准起点
上帝简一性的概念工程（《神学大全》第一集第三题）：逐项排除『组合』『形式与质料』『性质与主体』等每一个隐含复数的概念组合，使『上帝是单纯的』成为可用概念
恩宠与功德的划界：区分『先行恩宠』『随后功德』，化解奥古斯丁主义与半佩拉纠主义关于自由意志的世纪之争的一半语词之争
反例警示：概念精密化可能发展为经院化的繁琐主义——后期经院哲学的术语分裂数以百计、脱离经验约束后变成纯语词工程；定义工序必须服务于论证与观察，而非自成目的
representative_cases_en: The real distinction of existence and essence (De Ente et Essentia, c. 1256): 'essence can be thought without knowing whether it exists' cuts apart two concepts mixed since antiquity—the boundary became the standard starting point of later metaphysics

The concept engineering of divine simplicity (Summa I q.3): every composition implying plurality is excluded item by item—composition, form and matter, property and subject—making 'God is simple' a workable concept
Bounding grace and merit: distinguishing 'prevenient grace' from 'subsequent merit' dissolves half the word-war between Augustinianism and semi-Pelagianism over free will

Cautionary case: precision engineering can decay into scholastic hairsplitting—late scholasticism split terms by the hundreds, and freed from observational constraint became a purely verbal industry; definition must serve argument and observation, not become its own end
modern_applications_zh: 需求工程：为每个核心名词（『用户』『完成』『可用』）写属加种差定义与反例清单后再写第一行需求
跨团队对齐：会议前先做同词异解排查——『上线』『完成』『成功』在两支团队中常是不同概念
协议与 API 设计：字段与状态的定义文档优先于实现，混合使用两个相邻状态时的错误模式须显式写明
法律与合规：关键条款术语执行定义-划界-排查三道工序，把『歧义点清单』作为交付物
modern_applications_en: Requirements engineering: define each core noun ('user,' 'done,' 'available') by genus and difference with a counterexample list before the first requirement line
Cross-team alignment: run a homonym sweep before meetings—'launch,' 'done,' 'success' are often different concepts in the two teams
Protocol and API design: definition documents for fields and states precede implementation; error modes of mixing adjacent states must be written down explicitly
Law and compliance: run definition, boundary, and disambiguation on key clause terms, delivering an explicit 'ambiguity inventory'

modes.domain_zh: 谈论超验对象时的语言控制/既非单义也非歧义的第三种语义
modes.domain_en: Language Control for Speaking of Transcendent Objects / A Third Semantics beyond Univocity and Equivocity
modes.definition_zh: 『我们如何谈论我们无法完全理解的对象？』这是神学的元问题。当时两大方案都失败：单义论（说上帝『存在』与受造物『存在』意义完全相同）会摧毁超越性，歧义论（说上帝『存在』与受造物『存在』毫无共同之处）会摧毁一切谈论的可能性——两派论战（如阿奎那对阿威罗伊派与对特定神秘主义倾向）贯穿十三世纪。阿奎那的方案是第三条路：类比（analogia）。『健康』一词是标准模型：我们说『人是健康的』『食物是健康的』『面色是健康的』——三个句子中该词意义既不完全相同（否则食物就真有健康），也非毫不相干（否则言说无意义），而是围绕一个基准意义（人的健康）按不同关系（食物因其促进、面色因其指示）分布。对『存在』『善』『智慧』用于上帝与用于受造物，同理：意义围绕受造秩序中的基准意义，按因果关系比例化地分布——非单义、非歧义，而是『有控制的歧义』。方法签名：当一个词必须用于两个不同层级而单义会导致范畴错误时，不要在『同义』与『放弃言说』之间二选一——构造围绕基准意义按关系分布的类比系统，并显式标出每个用法与基准的关系类型。
modes.definition_en: 'How can we speak of what we cannot fully understand?'—theology's meta-question. Both reigning answers failed: univocity ('exists' means exactly the same of God and creatures) destroys transcendence; equivocity ('exists' of God shares nothing with 'exists' of creatures) destroys all intelligible speech—the dispute ran through the thirteenth century. Aquinas's answer was a third path: analogy. 'Healthy' is the standard model: we say 'the person is healthy,' 'the food is healthy,' 'the complexion is healthy'—the word's meaning in the three sentences is neither identical (else food would literally have health) nor unrelated (else speech were meaningless) but distributed around a focal meaning (the person's health) by different relations (food by promoting it, complexion by signifying it). So for 'being,' 'good,' and 'wise' said of God and of creatures: meaning clusters around the focal use within the created order and is proportioned by causal relation—neither univocal nor equivocal but 'controlled ambiguity.' Method signature: when one word must serve two levels and univocity would commit a category error, do not choose between 'same meaning' and 'silence'—build an analogical system distributed by relation around the focal meaning, marking explicitly how each use relates to it.
modes.source_chapter: 《神学大全》第一集第十三题『论上帝的名称』（单义、歧义、类比三分与比例类比）；《论真理》第二题；《反异教大全》第一卷第二十九至三十四章
modes.key_quote_zh: 我们说上帝是善的，不是说上帝具有受造物的那种善，而是说受造物的善以某种方式源于上帝——同一个词，两种关系。
modes.key_quote_en: When we say God is good, we do not mean God has creaturely goodness, but that creaturely goodness proceeds from God in some way—the same word, two relations.
process_zh: 识别必须跨层级使用的核心词：标注其单义使用会产生的范畴错误
确定基准意义：在可直接把握的层级上固定该词的焦点用法（如『人的健康』）
为每一个延伸用法标注关系类型：因果（因其产生）、指示（因其象征）、比例（因其对应）
检验歧义控制：检查延伸用法是否仍与基准意义连通——失去连通的用法即退化为纯歧义，须废弃或重新定义
process_en: Identify the core words that must cross levels: mark the category error univocal use would produce
Fix the focal meaning: anchor the word's central use on the directly graspable level (as 'human health')
Tag each extended use with its relation type: causal (because it produces), significative (because it symbolizes), proportional (because it corresponds)
Test ambiguity control: verify each extension remains connected to the focal meaning—use that loses connection has decayed into mere equivocation and must be dropped or redefined
representative_cases_zh: 『上帝的名称』问题（第一集第十三题，约1265-1274）：以单义/歧义/类比三分判定宗教语言的语义地位，成为此后七百年神学语言哲学的标准框架
『健康』模型：用『健康的人/健康的食物/健康的气色』三个用法的同一与差异，把抽象的类比学说变成人人可验的语义样本
对两个极端的对称作战：既驳单义论者把上帝语言人类化，也驳否定一切神学言说可能的否定神学激进派——第三条路同时承受两翼火力
反例警示：类比若无基准意义锚定，会滑向无限类比的含混——后人（如司各脱派）批评阿奎那的类比理论在『多明确算有控制』上缺乏判准；类比系统本身需要元标准，否则只是精致的歧义
representative_cases_en: The question of divine names (I q.13, c. 1265-1274): the univocal/equivocal/analogical trichotomy fixed the semantic status of religious language—the standard framework for seven centuries of theological philosophy of language
The 'healthy' model: the sameness and difference across 'healthy person / healthy food / healthy complexion' turns an abstract doctrine into a semantic sample anyone can verify

Symmetrical combat on two flanks: refuting univocists who humanize God-language while also refuting radical negation-theology that forbids all theological speech—the third path takes fire from both wings

Cautionary case: analogy without an anchored focal meaning slides into unbounded vagueness—Scotist critics charged that Aquinas's theory lacked a criterion for 'controlled enough'; the analogical system itself needs a meta-standard, else it is merely refined equivocation
modern_applications_zh: 跨领域术语移植：把物理学的『熵』『能量』用于社会学时，显式标注其与原域用法的关系类型（比喻/因果/比例），防止概念漂移
模型可解释性：对『模型理解了X』这类跨层级语句，构造类比语义——标注该说法与人类理解的连通点与断裂点
产品与营销语言：『智能』『学习』等词用于机器时的用法规范——单义夸大、歧义失效，类比标注是合规且诚实的第三条路
组织隐喻治理：『公司像家庭』『团队像球队』等隐喻标注其支撑点与失效点，防止隐喻被单义化地字面执行
modern_applications_en: Cross-domain term transplant: when physics' 'entropy' or 'energy' migrates into social science, tag the relation type to the home use (metaphor/causal/proportional) to stop concept drift
Model interpretability: for cross-level sentences like 'the model understands X,' build an analogical semantics—marking where the claim connects to and breaks from human understanding
Product and marketing language: norms for 'intelligent' and 'learns' applied to machines—univocity overclaims, equivocity fails; annotated analogy is the compliant, honest third path
Organizational metaphor governance: tag the load-bearing points and failure points of 'the company is a family' or 'the team is a squad,' keeping metaphors from being executed literally

modes.domain_zh: 在依赖权威传统的体系内管理权威分歧/以结构而非服从解决引文冲突
modes.domain_en: Managing Conflicts among Authorities within a Tradition / Resolving Citation Clashes by Structure, Not Submission
modes.definition_zh: 经院体系建在权威文本之上——圣经、教父、亚里士多德、教会法；但权威之间互相矛盾（阿贝拉尔的《是与否》辑录即为此危机而生）。阿奎那的处理是一套权威分级与制衡系统：其一，分层——圣经最高，教父与哲学家按论题领域分级，同一权威在不同论题上的权重不同（亚里士多德在自然哲学近乎决定性，在启示问题上只是『那位哲学家』）；其二，领域匹配——引证必须匹配论题的账本（见双重真理分账法）：神学问题引神学权威，哲学问题引哲学权威，跨账本引用只作辅助不作裁决；其三，文本考订——引用前先确认文本真伪与版本，伪托之作不得入引（他与大阿尔伯特都做过《论伪托狄奥尼修斯》式的鉴定工作）；其四，结构制衡——在问难结构中，正方与反方的引文同等出场，最终裁决权在推理（respondeo）而非任何引文：『权威的论证力最弱』是他在《神学大全》第一集第一题第八释疑中的明文原则。方法签名：在权威驱动的体系里，把权威从『论证的终点』降格为『论证的证据之一』——分歧不由更大的权威裁决，而由能把所有权威安置进结构的推理裁决。
modes.definition_en: The scholastic system stood on authoritative texts—Scripture, the Fathers, Aristotle, canon law; yet the authorities contradicted one another (Abelard's Sic et Non existed because of this crisis). Aquinas's answer was a system of grading and balancing: first, tiering—Scripture highest; Fathers and philosophers tiered by topic, the same authority weighted differently on different questions (Aristotle near-decisive in natural philosophy, merely 'the Philosopher' on revelation); second, domain matching—citations must match the question's ledger (see the two-fold truth ledger): theological questions cite theological authorities, philosophical questions philosophical ones, cross-ledger citation auxiliary only, never decisive; third, textual vetting—confirm authenticity and version before citing; spurious works are barred (he and Albert the Great both did authentication work in the Dionysian tradition); fourth, structural balance—in the quaestio, affirmative and opposing citations appear on equal terms, and final ruling belongs to reasoning (respondeo), not to any citation: 'the argument from authority is the weakest' is his explicit principle at Summa I q.1 a.8 ad 2. Method signature: in an authority-driven system, demote authority from 'the end of argument' to 'one item of evidence'—disputes are settled not by a bigger authority but by the reasoning that can place every authority within the structure.
modes.source_chapter: 《神学大全》第一集第一题第八释疑二『权威的论证力最弱』；各问题中正反引文的对称运用；《波爱修斯〈论三位一体〉评注》论理性与权威的分工
modes.key_quote_zh: 由权威得出的论证力量最弱——权威只能说服人接受，不能证明人所应理解的东西。
modes.key_quote_en: The argument from authority is the weakest of all—authority can induce assent, but cannot produce the understanding a demonstration gives.
process_zh: 建立权威分层表：按论题领域为每类权威定级，标明其在何处具有裁决力、何处仅具参考力
引文与论题的账本匹配：跨账本引用须显式标注其辅助身份，禁止用神学权威裁决哲学问题或反之
引用前考订：确认文本真伪、版本与语境，伪托与断章之作不入围
裁决权交给推理：在问难结构中令正反引文对称出场，最终结论由独立论证承担，引文仅作证据
process_en: Build an authority tier table: grade every class of authority by topic, marking where it is decisive and where merely advisory
Match citation to ledger: cross-ledger citation must be tagged as auxiliary; theological authority never rules on philosophical questions or vice versa
Vet before citing: confirm authenticity, version, and context; spurious and quote-mined texts are barred
Give the ruling to reasoning: in the quaestio, affirmative and opposing citations appear symmetrically; the conclusion rests on independent argument, citations as evidence only
representative_cases_zh: 第一集第一题第八释疑：他一面为神学大量引证权威，一面明文宣布『权威的论证力最弱』——在权威最密集的体系里给权威降格，是该方法最自觉的展示
亚里士多德的双面权重：在伦理学与自然哲学问题中被引为决定性，在创世问题上仅被当作需要检验的哲学家——同一权威按账本重新定级
对教父分歧的结构化处理：奥古斯丁与狄奥尼修斯表述冲突时，他不裁决谁对，而是用类比法证明两者在各自语义层面均真——权威分歧被转化为语义分层问题
反例警示：新教改革者后来把『唯有圣经』的极端化反向运用于托马斯主义——权威制衡系统依赖『权威之上还有推理』的共识，一旦各方连这条元原则都不共认，分层表本身就会成为新的战场
representative_cases_en: Summa I q.1 a.8 ad 2: while citing authorities voluminously for theology he states in plain words that 'the argument from authority is the weakest'—demoting authority inside the most authority-dense system, the method's most self-aware display
Aristotle's double weight: decisive in ethics and natural philosophy, merely a philosopher-to-be-tested on creation—the same authority re-tiered by ledger

Structured handling of patristic conflict: when Augustine and pseudo-Dionysius seem to clash, he does not pick a winner but shows by analogy both are true at their semantic levels—converting authority conflict into semantic stratification

Cautionary case: Protestant reformers later turned 'Scripture alone' against Thomism with equal and opposite extremity—an authority-balancing system depends on the shared meta-principle that reasoning stands above authority; once the parties cease to share even that, the tier table itself becomes the battlefield
modern_applications_zh: 循证决策：为证据源分层（随机试验>观察研究>专家意见），并明文承认『任何单一引证都不是结论』
文档引用规范：竞品文档、内部benchmark、客户访谈各自定级，跨级引用显式标注辅助身份
AI 辅助写作：把模型输出当作『需要考订的权威引文』而非结论——核验出处、版本与语境后再入正文
组织知识治理：对『CEO说过』『客户要求』『行业惯例』建立分层表，裁决权留在独立推理
modern_applications_en: Evidence-based decision: tier evidence sources (RCTs > observational > expert opinion) and state in writing that no single citation settles anything
Citation norms in documents: grade competitor docs, internal benchmarks, and customer interviews; cross-tier citation must be tagged auxiliary
AI-assisted writing: treat model output as 'authority requiring vetting,' not conclusion—verify source, version, and context before it enters the body text
Organizational knowledge governance: tier 'the CEO said,' 'the customer requires,' 'industry practice'; the ruling stays with independent reasoning

modes.domain_zh: 面对不能共享预设的对手/以其体系内部标准构造对其最有利的论证
modes.domain_en: Facing Rivals Who Share No Presuppositions / Building the Best Case for Them from Their Own Internal Standards
modes.definition_zh: 《反异教大全》面对的读者不接受圣经权威——这是基督教论辩史上第一次必须在『无共同预设』条件下作战的系统性尝试。阿奎那的解决方案是方法论的革命：其一，论证材料全面切换——全书前四卷几乎不引圣经，只用自然理性、共同经验与双方都接受的哲学权威（亚里士多德是双方共同遗产）；其二，以对手的最强形式作战——他先用数卷篇幅把异教立场（如世界的永恒、神意、灵魂性质）以最完备的形式重构出来，再展开反驳；其三，用对手体系内部的裂隙作战——反驳伊斯兰或犹太哲学立场时，他优先使用该传统内部的分歧（阿维森纳与阿威罗伊的互诘）而非外部强加的标准；其四，为失败预留诚实通道——他承认有些真理理性无法达到，此时论辩目标从『说服』降级为『移除障碍』：证明对方的反驳并不成立即可。方法签名：对不共享预设的对手，把说服标准从『接受我的结论』改为『在我的体系中找不到可维持的反驳』——用对方的标准作战，赢得的是对方标准下的胜利。
modes.definition_en: Summa Contra Gentiles addressed readers who reject biblical authority—the first systematic attempt in Christian polemics to fight under 'no shared presuppositions.' Aquinas's solution was methodological revolution: first, a wholesale switch of materials—the first four books cite Scripture barely at all, using only natural reason, common experience, and philosophical authorities both sides accept (Aristotle as shared inheritance); second, fighting the rival's strongest form—he spends whole books reconstructing pagan positions (the world's eternity, providence, the soul's nature) in their most complete form before refuting; third, fighting from within the rival's own fissures—against Islamic or Jewish philosophical positions he prefers each tradition's internal disputes (Avicenna versus Averroes) to standards imposed from outside; fourth, an honest fallback—he concedes some truths reason cannot reach, and there the polemical goal downgrades from 'persuasion' to 'obstacle removal': showing the rival's objections do not stand suffices. Method signature: with a rival sharing no presuppositions, reset the standard of success from 'accept my conclusion' to 'no sustainable objection remains in your own system'—fight by the rival's own standards and the victory won is a victory by those standards.
modes.source_chapter: 《反异教大全》第一卷第二至九章（论辩模式的自觉声明）；第二、三卷对世界永恒、神意等异教论题的先重构后反驳；第四卷论奥秘的处理方式
modes.key_quote_zh: 对不接受我的经典的人，我必须只用他也承认的理性作战——这更难，但也更干净。
modes.key_quote_en: Against one who rejects my Scriptures, I must fight only with a reason he too accepts—harder, but cleaner.
process_zh: 清点与对手共享的论证资源：共同经验、共同认可的权威、对方传统内部的推理标准
以对手体系内部资源重构其立场至最强形式，并请对方确认重构无遗漏
优先从对方传统内部的裂隙作战：用阿维森纳驳阿威罗伊式的内部分歧，而非外部强加标准
对理性不可及的真理降级目标：不求说服，只证明对方的反驳在其自身标准下也不成立——移除障碍即胜利
process_en: Inventory argument resources shared with the rival: common experience, mutually accepted authorities, the standards internal to the rival's own tradition
Reconstruct the rival's position to its strongest form using the rival's own resources, and have the rival confirm the reconstruction omits nothing
Fight from inside the rival's fissures first: internal disputes (Avicenna against Averroes) rather than externally imposed standards
Downgrade the goal for truths reason cannot reach: seek not persuasion but obstacle removal—showing the rival's objections fail by the rival's own standards is victory enough
representative_cases_zh: 《反异教大全》前四卷（约1259-1265）：几乎零圣经引文的神学巨著——为跨信仰论辩而设计的『公共理性』文本，比罗尔斯的 overlapping consensus 早七百年
世界永恒论的重构与反驳（第二卷）：他先以亚里士多德的最强形式重构『世界永恒』论证，再证明其并非必然——并用同一套工具证明『世界有开端』亦非理性可证（与分账法衔接）
用阿维森纳反驳阿威罗伊：处理理智单一论时大量调用穆斯林哲学内部的分歧——对手内部的标准比外部权威更有杀伤力
反例警示：最强形式重构耗时巨大——《反异教大全》为每个异教立场花费的篇幅远超反驳本身，在实际论辩时间有限时该方法成本极高；现代辩论实践中它常败给稻草人战术的速度优势
representative_cases_en: The first four books of Summa Contra Gentiles (c. 1259-1265): a massive theological work with near-zero Scriptural citation—a 'public reason' text designed for interfaith disputation, seven centuries before Rawls's overlapping consensus

Reconstructing and refuting the world's eternity (Book II): the Aristotelian case for an eternal world rebuilt at full strength, then shown non-necessary—and by the same tools 'the world began' shown not rationally provable (meshing with the ledger method)
Avicenna against Averroes: on the unity of intellect he leans on divisions inside Muslim philosophy—a rival's internal standards cut deeper than external authority

Cautionary case: strongest-form reconstruction is enormously costly—Contra Gentiles spends far more space per pagan position on reconstruction than on refutation; under real debate time limits the method loses to the sheer speed of straw-manning
modern_applications_zh: 跨文化产品谈判：以对方企业内部的 KPI 与先例构造支持方案的论证，而非输出己方标准
开源社区协作：为上游维护者重构『拒绝该 PR 的最强理由』并获其确认，再逐条回应——拒绝稻草人化的 PR 驳回
安全审计的红蓝对抗：红队以攻击者自身工具链与目标重构攻击面，防御按攻击者标准而非合规标准优化
政策论证：对不接受前提的公众，只用共同经验与双方数据源论证，并明示哪些主张属于价值选择而非事实推断
modern_applications_en: Cross-cultural dealmaking: build the case from the counterpart's internal KPIs and precedents rather than exporting your own standards
Open-source collaboration: reconstruct the maintainer's strongest reasons for rejecting the PR, get their confirmation, then reply point by point—a strawman-free rejection protocol
Red/blue security exercises: the red team rebuilds the attack surface with the attacker's own toolchain and goals; defense optimizes by attacker standards, not compliance checklists
Policy argument: with publics that reject your premises, argue only from common experience and data sources both sides accept, marking explicitly which claims are value choices rather than inference

modes.domain_zh: 把一个学科重组为可检索、可教学、单元自足的课程体系
modes.domain_en: Reorganizing a Discipline into a Retrievable, Teachable, Unit-Self-Sufficient Curriculum
modes.definition_zh: 此前神学教学依附于彼得·隆巴德的《箴言四书》——一部按教父引文排列、无内在秩序的汇编。阿奎那用《神学大全》重新发明了学科的载体：其一，三重分类架构——整个神学按『论上帝（一集）/论受造物走向上帝（二集）/论基督与圣事（三集）』三段组织，二集内部再按『人的最后目的—德性—恶—特殊德性』递归分解，每一层都有明确的包含关系；其二，单元自足——每个问难（quaestio）自成完整单元：问题、反方、裁决、回应齐备，可单独取出教学而不损其义；其三，互相引用——单元之间用『如前所述』式内链与编号系统连接，形成可导航的网络而非线性书卷；其四，为教学而设计——每个单元长度均匀（约一课时），难度按学习顺序递进，先易后难、先一般后特殊。结果是历史上第一部真正意义的『学科教科书』：读者可从任一单元进入体系、可按编号检索、可按顺序学完。方法签名：一门学科的成熟不在于其内容的量，而在于其是否被组织成一个新人拿得动的结构——架构本身是知识的最重要产品。
modes.definition_en: Theology teaching had depended on Peter Lombard's Four Books of Sentences—an assemblage ordered by patristic citation with no intrinsic order. With the Summa Theologiae Aquinas reinvented the carrier of a discipline: first, a triple classification—the whole of theology organized as 'on God (Prima Pars) / on the creature's movement toward God (Secunda Pars) / on Christ and the sacraments (Tertia Pars),' the second part recursively divided from 'man's last end' through virtues, vice, and particular virtues, every level with explicit containment; second, unit self-sufficiency—each quaestio is a complete unit (question, objections, ruling, replies), detachable for teaching without loss of sense; third, cross-referencing—units linked by internal citation and numbering into a navigable network rather than a linear scroll; fourth, designed for teaching—units of even length (about one lesson), difficulty graded by learning order, easy before hard, general before particular. The result was history's first true 'textbook of a discipline': a reader can enter the system at any unit, retrieve by number, and finish by sequence. Method signature: a discipline's maturity lies not in the mass of its content but in whether it is organized into a structure a newcomer can lift—the architecture is knowledge's most important product.
modes.source_chapter: 《神学大全》全书架构（第一集序言明确陈述教学目的与架构设计：『论神圣教义应以何种秩序与方式传授』）
modes.key_quote_zh: 神圣教义的传授应当有与内容相称的秩序——初学者需要的不是材料的堆叠，而是一条能走完的路。
modes.key_quote_en: The teaching of sacred doctrine should have an order suited to its matter—beginners need not a heap of material but a road that can be walked to the end.
process_zh: 设计顶层分类：按对象的内在秩序（上帝—受造物—基督）而非引文或传统顺序组织全部内容
递归分解：每一层按统一标准再分，保持包含关系明确、无交叉重叠
单元化并保证自足：每个单元具备问题、论证、裁决、回应的完整闭环，可独立教学
铺设内链与编号系统：单元互相引用、可检索、长度与难度为学习路径优化，最后为体系写总体序言说明用法
process_en: Design the top classification: organize all content by the intrinsic order of the objects (God—creatures—Christ), not by citation or tradition
Decompose recursively: split each level by a uniform criterion with unambiguous containment and no overlap
Unitize with self-sufficiency: every unit carries the full loop of question, argument, ruling, replies, teachable alone
Lay in internal links and numbering: units cross-cite, are retrievable, length and difficulty optimized for the learning path—and write the general preface explaining how to use it
representative_cases_zh: 《神学大全》三集架构（1265-1274）：第一部现代式学科教科书，直到二十世纪仍是天主教修院的标准课程——架构寿命超过其任何一个论证
二集一（Prima Secundae）的递归设计：从『人的最后目的』逐层展开到具体德性与恶——每一层的划分标准在前言中显式声明
未完成的第三集：他临终停笔于圣事部分，补写者依其笔记续成——架构预先容纳了『未完成』：单元化设计使他人续写不破坏整体
反例警示：大全式架构后来被托马斯主义僵化为『标准答案集』——问难单元本是开放的论辩训练，被使用为背诵单元；架构的生命力在于持续被教学重演，而非被当作圣物供奉
representative_cases_en: The Summa's three-part architecture (1265-1274): the first modern-style textbook of a discipline, still the standard curriculum in Catholic seminaries in the twentieth century—the architecture has outlived every one of its arguments
The recursive design of Prima Secundae: unfolding from 'man's last end' to particular virtues and vices—the criterion of division declared explicitly at each stage

The unfinished Tertia Pars: he stopped at the sacraments on his deathbed; continuators completed it from his notes—the architecture had pre-admitted incompletion: unit design lets others continue without breaking the whole

Cautionary case: Thomism later froze the Summa into a 'book of standard answers'—quaestio units meant as open argumentative training were used as recitation units; an architecture stays alive only through being re-enacted in teaching, not enshrined as relic
modern_applications_zh: 文档工程：把团队知识库从『按时间堆放的文档』重组为递归分类+单元自足+互相引用的课程结构，并写总体导航序言
课程设计：先设计架构再填充内容——每讲长度均匀、难度递进、单元可独立成课
微服务架构：按业务对象的内在秩序划分服务边界（而非按团队或历史），每个服务自足且互相引用显式化
开源项目文档：README/教程/参考/原理四层结构，新手路径与检索路径分离设计
modern_applications_en: Documentation engineering: rebuild a team wiki from time-stacked pages into recursive classification, self-sufficient units, cross-links—and write the general navigation preface
Course design: architecture first, content second—lectures of even length, graded difficulty, each unit teachable alone
Microservice architecture: bound services by the intrinsic order of business objects (not by teams or history); each service self-sufficient with explicit cross-references
Open-source docs: a four-layer structure (README/tutorial/reference/theory) with newcomer and lookup paths designed separately

modes.name_zh: 临终静默与遗产移交法
modes.domain_zh: 体系完成度的自觉与传承移交/在终点放弃'再改一次'的执念
modes.domain_en: Self-Aware Completion and Handover of a System / Relinquishing the Urge for 'One More Revision' at the End
modes.definition_zh: 1273年12月6日，那不勒斯弥撒中，阿奎那经历了后世所称的神秘体验，自此搁笔——《神学大全》停在第90题，未完成。他对秘书雷金纳德说：『凡我至此所写，于我皆如稻草。』三个月后他死于去里昂会议途中。方法论上这是被低估的一课：其一，完成度的自觉——他清楚知道未完成处（他在临终前最后的著作中重列了体系尚未回答的问题），也清楚知道哪些部分已经稳固；其二，把未完成设计为可续写的接口——《大全》的单元化架构使续写者（他的学生依其笔记补成三集）不破坏整体即可补全，未完成不是失败而是预留的扩展点；其三，终点停止的决断——在体系已达到『他人可以接手』的状态后放弃修改，拒绝把晚年变成对早年体系的反复涂抹；其四，遗产的口头移交——最后的对话（对雷金纳德的『稻草』之言与其笔记的交付）本身就是一次设计过的移交仪式：他留下的不是成品而是『成品+图纸+维护者』的完整组合。方法签名：体系的最后一件作品不是它的最后一卷书，而是它的移交设计——知道何时停止，与知道如何交付，是同一件事的两半。
modes.definition_en: On 6 December 1273, at Mass in Naples, Aquinas underwent what posterity calls a mystical experience and laid down his pen for good—the Summa Theologiae halting at question 90, unfinished. To his secretary Reginald he said: 'All that I have written seems like straw to me.' Three months later he died on the road to the Council of Lyon. Methodologically this is an underrated lesson: first, self-awareness of completion—he knew exactly what remained unfinished (listing the system's unanswered questions in his last works) and which parts stood firm; second, designing the unfinished as a continuable interface—the Summa's unit architecture let continuators (his students, from his notes, completing the third part) finish the whole without breaking it; incompletion was not failure but a reserved extension point; third, the decision to stop at the end—having reached the state 'others can take over,' he relinquished revision, refusing to spend his last years repainting his early system; fourth, oral handover of the legacy—the final conversation (the 'straw' remark to Reginald and the delivery of his notes) was itself a designed handover ritual: what he left was not a finished product but the complete bundle of 'product + blueprint + maintainer.' Method signature: a system's final work is not its last volume but its handover design—knowing when to stop and knowing how to deliver are two halves of the same act.
modes.source_chapter: 1273年12月6日那不勒斯停笔事件（秘书雷金纳德的记录传统）；《神学大全》第三集的续写（学生依其《论圣事》笔记补成）；传记传统中的『稻草』名言
modes.key_quote_zh: 凡我至此所写，于我皆如稻草——接下来的工作属于能接手的人。
modes.key_quote_en: All that I have written seems like straw to me—the work that remains belongs to those who can take over.
process_zh: 盘点体系状态：明确列出已完成且稳固的部分与未完成的接口，把清单写成文档
确保移交三件套齐备：成品（正文）、图纸（笔记与设计说明）、维护者（受过训练的接手人）
预演续写：以单元化架构检验他人能否在不破坏整体的前提下补全未完成部分
执行停止：达到可移交状态后停止修订，把最后的精力投入移交仪式与培养接手者，而非涂抹既有成果
process_en: Take inventory of the system: list the finished-and-solid parts and the unfinished interfaces, written down as a document
Ensure the handover triad: the product (the text), the blueprint (notes and design rationale), and the maintainers (trained successors)
Rehearse continuation: use the unit architecture to test whether others can complete the unfinished parts without breaking the whole
Execute the stop: once handover-ready, cease revising and spend the last effort on the handover ritual and on training successors, not on repainting the existing work
representative_cases_zh: 《神学大全》的未完成（1273-1274）：停在第90题，学生依其笔记补成第三集——未完成处被架构预先消化，续写本与原作一体流传至今
『稻草』名言的移交功能：对亲传弟子而非公众说出的自我否定，既是谦辞也是指令——『不要拜我的文字，要接我的工作』
里昂会议之行的托付：临终前仍被教廷征召，他把最后的旅行变成体系的公开交付（携带全部著作赴会）
反例警示：『稻草』之言被后世神秘主义化，用于暗示其全部工作可弃——停止修订与否定成果是两回事；移交设计的遗产必须防止被误读为对体系本身的清算
representative_cases_en: The Summa left unfinished (1273-1274): halted at question 90, completed by students from his notes—the unfinished part pre-digested by the architecture, the continuation transmitted as one with the original to this day
The 'straw' remark as handover function: a self-negation spoken to his closest disciple, not the public—both humility and instruction: 'do not venerate my words; take up my work'
The journey to Lyon as bequest: summoned by the pope on his deathbed, he turned his last journey into the system's public delivery, carrying his works to the council

Cautionary case: posterity mystified the 'straw' remark into a hint that the whole work may be discarded—ceasing to revise is not repudiating the achievement; a handover design must guard against being misread as a reckoning with the system itself
modern_applications_zh: 创始人退出设计：公司/开源项目创始人在体系『可被他人接手』后停止亲改，把精力转向培养维护者与移交文档
离职交接工程：交付三件套——成品、设计决策记录（图纸）、接手人训练计划——把未完成项显式列为扩展点而非掩盖
项目终点管理：设定『停止修订』的客观判据，达到后冻结主线、开放续写分支，防止无限返工
个人知识遗产：定期为最重要工作写『移交文档』（现状/设计理由/未决问题），使任何一天缺席都可交接
modern_applications_en: Founder exit design: once the system is 'takeover-ready,' the founder of a company or open-source project stops personal revision and turns to training maintainers and handover docs
Offboarding engineering: deliver the triad—product, decision record (blueprint), successor training plan—with unfinished items listed explicitly as extension points, not hidden
Project endgame management: set objective criteria for 'stop revising'; on reaching them freeze the mainline and open continuation branches against endless rework
Personal knowledge legacy: write a handover document (state/design rationale/open questions) for your most important work regularly, so any absence on any day is handover-ready
